jsonld_raw.name: DOLCE NOSTALGIA VANILLA & INCENSE PARFUM 100ML
jsonld_raw.description:
DOLCE NOSTALGIA VANILLA & INCENSE PARFUM 100ML. The Art of Becoming, a collection inspired by the journey toward your most authentic self. The memory of a night that stays with you long after it ends. Dim lights, shared laughter, and the feeling that some moments leave an imprint forever. Plum liquor and leather create an intense, refined opening, while vanilla caviar absolute reveals a deep, enveloping richness that lingers on the skin.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Vanilla Amber | Opulent, warm, and deep.
